title: Repayment of Advanced Property Charges Out of HECM Scheduled Payments
content:
Added to the withholdings from a new Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) scheduled payment is the repayment of a property charge Cedarline advanced, a loan holding at most one open property charge repayment record (its Property Charge Advance Repayment record).

**By the state of the record:**

| Open repayment record | Withholding |
|---|---|
| notice period, pending signature or defaulted, with an arrearage balance above 0.00 | the arrearage spread evenly over twelve payments: the arrearage balance divided by 12, rounded half up to the cent |
| active, with a monthly installment above 0.00 | the plan's own monthly installment, passed through |
| any other case | nothing |

*Hypothetical:* a defaulted record with an arrearage balance of 1000.00 gives 83.333…, withheld as 83.33; an active record with a monthly installment of 145.00 gives 145.00; an active record whose monthly installment is 0.00 gives nothing.
